correctness.rationale: The SU(2) character product has a multiplicity-one spectrum in steps of two. An exact overlap count at m>=max(S) yields mF(c)+B_S(c), with |B_S| <= (L+1)|S|^2 on the unit sphere. Cauchy-Schwarz and phase alignment reduce F to Q(x); solving Q gives the three branches and the unique limiting profiles. Uniform convergence plus compactness establishes localization. The embedded 216-case exact small-integer verification cross-checks the expansion; no finite extrapolation is used.
